Cars With Sam: on-device vehicle background removal

U2-Net model and project: https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net
Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE-U2Net.txt. Model distributed through rembg's u2netp release.

ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
MIT License; see LICENSE-ONNX-Runtime.txt.

Normalization and mask processing based on rembg: https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg
MIT License; see LICENSE-rembg.txt.

Local integration: https://github.com/S81S/sam-ryan-site
Photos are processed on the visitor's device. The model's output is a visual cutout, not a vehicle dimension or equipment verification.
